control.description: No intentional delay, jitter, packet loss, or rate cap

moderate_combined.description: Rate cap, delay, jitter, and loss

severe_combined.description: Stronger rate cap, delay, jitter, and loss

notes: These are PILOT profiles, not validated models of a particular cellular network.
tc netem affects egress only. Bidirectional effects require deliberate shaping at both endpoints or a suitable topology.
Delay correlation models correlation between successive delay variations; it is not packet-loss correlation.
Do not apply until the selected interface is verified to carry WebRTC media packets.
Live runner is fail-closed and only accepts a disposable veth with default noqueue root; it is not yet the physical two-endpoint impairment path.
